<!--
Thanks for contributing to DVARA. A few things to check before you submit.

⚠️ Security vulnerabilities

STOP. If this fixes a security vulnerability, do not open a pull request — the diff
discloses the flaw publicly before anyone can upgrade. See SECURITY.md.

📝 The CLA

Your contribution is accepted under Apache-2.0 — section 5 already licenses anything
submitted for inclusion, so most changes need no paperwork.

For a substantial change we may ask you to sign CLA.md, and we will say so here if it
applies. It is one comment, checked by a person. You keep your copyright either way.
Contributions made in the course of employment need a corporate agreement in addition
to the individual one; CLA.md explains it.

⚖️ Where the change belongs

This repository is the open-source LLM Gateway. Some components are not published here.
If this change moves something across that line it is a product decision rather than a
code review. Raising an issue first is the cheaper order for both of us.

✍️ Describing your change

The diff already says what changed. What it cannot say is what went wrong, what else
you tried, and what you decided against — please put that here. If this fixes a bug,
describe the broken behaviour and why this fixes it. Reference any related issue by
number, prefixed with #.

A good pull request is one change, with a test that would have failed without it, and
no unrelated reformatting. CONTRIBUTING.md has the longer version.
-->
